name: The Deep Freeze
tradition: The First Slice now starts every Deep-Dish home kickoff: a local pizzeria captain carves a six-foot pie at midfield, the Casserole Crew watches the cheese pull hit the yard marker, and the lake-wind roar tells the visiting sideline the crust is holding.

cue.label: The First Slice
cue.pregameLine: The six-foot pie is rolling to midfield at The Deep Freeze, and the cheese pull is stretching into kickoff weather.
cue.crowdResponse: The Casserole Crew answers with a DEEP! DISH! chant that lands like an oven door in January.
